I switch between agents so frequently that doing that would be counterproductive, as a memory saved to one provider's harness location is not accessible to another coding agent. define Logseq/Entity/AI/Model/Doc/API entity, which should point to and represent the official API docs page for a specific model. This should be official documentation page (for example, for Claude Fable 5.1 https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/overview would be that, for GPT-6 Sol, it would be https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-sol. define Logseq/Entity/AI/Model/Doc/Analysis to be a page in the garden for an external webpage that represents statistics, metrics, and analysis about a particular AI model from a particular provider, for example, the h1 at the top of the page would link to Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback) - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis would be an example of this type of page, and the contents would optionally summarize some of the top findings.

define Logseq/Entity/AI/Leaderboard entity to be a page in the garden that has an up-to-date / current list of references to AI models along with scores along a particular dimension. The prototype for this is the highlights from https://artificialanalysis.ai/, which includes leaderboards for dimensions Intelligence, Speed, Cost per Task. The models that I track in this garden should be linked, along with their score. The scores should be presented in descending order, so the first item listed in the page is the most desirable for the metric.
